rows.grounds: fused compound modifying dhūpam; dhvasta (destroyed) + durvāsana (bad vasana)
sandhi fusion of unmīlayāmi + aham; first-person singular active present

items.question: What declaration accompanies the offering of divine incense?
items.inference: The offering declares purification of latent tendencies through divine incense.
items.plain_english: I open divine incense that destroys bad latent tendencies.
